remarks: Welcome to your new home! This spacious and modern 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment is a perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Enjoy an open-concept layout with ample natural light, perfect for entertaining or relaxing. Modern Kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and plenty of storage space. Generously sized bedrooms with large closets. The master bedroom includes an ensuite bathroom for added privacy. In-Unit Laundry washer and dryer included for your convenience. Private outdoor space to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind in the evening. Access to a fitness center located on the first floor. Location is conveniently situated close to shopping, dining, and public transportation.   Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity!
